stopConditions: FULL_BUILD preflight cannot fit the 1,250,000-token reserve
Builder returns failure or times out
natural-input QA fails and would require FixerAgent
total agent token usage exceeds the authorized ceiling
rationale: BLUEPRINT completed but used 1,119,293 tokens because Codex agent turns repeatedly count the large system context. The factory now supports an explicit per-stage reserve and passes routed reasoning to Codex CLI. This proposal funds exactly one bounded Builder attempt and QA.
